input.summary: Calibrate the flippers, then shoot the right bullseye chute from the left flipper. The bullseye feeds the saucer that collects the current bonus without resetting it. Complete the five-bank when one safe shot advances Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: Bullseye and Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: The right bullseye scores 10,000 and one bonus step, or 30,000 and three steps when lit, before the saucer collects bonus.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each five-bank completion advances 2X, 3X, 5X, then 10X while base bonus grows to 12,000.

quickInfo.name: Five-bank
quickInfo.summary: The right drop bank advances Bonus X and one bonus step, and its first two completions light opposite 30,000 outlanes.

quickInfo.name: Three-bank
quickInfo.summary: The left bank scores 5,000, 10,000, 15,000, 20,000, then 30,000 on successive completions.

quickInfo.name: Top saucer
quickInfo.summary: Its rotating award can advance bonus, advance Bonus X, light 5,000 inlanes, or light the bullseye for 30,000 and three steps.

steps.text: Before the first scoring switch, plunge for the top saucer when its cycling award can light the bullseye for 30,000 and three bonus steps.
On the first ball, make controlled flips and learn whether this copy has curved or straight flipper bats.
Use the left flipper to shoot the right bullseye chute whenever its return is controlled.
Collect the current base bonus and multiplier when the ball enters the right saucer.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: The saucer scores the current base bonus times Bonus X. The base bonus does not reset after this collect.

steps.text: From the right flipper, shoot the left three-bank so its rebound can also hit the five-bank.
Complete the five-bank when one controlled hit advances Bonus X.
modeNotes: Bonus X: Five-bank completions advance 2X, 3X, 5X, then 10X. Each completion also adds one bonus step.

steps.text: At 10X, return to the bullseye and collect as much as 120,000 at the right saucer.
Complete the five-bank once after that collect to restore 10X, then repeat the bullseye route.

fallback.title: Recovery: Cross-bank multiplier route
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the bullseye chute rejects or the saucer eject is unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the three-bank from the right flipper.
Use rebounds into the five-bank to collect safer incidental progress.
Complete the five-bank to advance Bonus X.
Protect the built end-of-ball bonus instead of forcing the right chute.

alternatives.title: Position play: Three-bank Extra Ball
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this only when Extra Balls have tournament value and the left bank is controlled.

steps.text: Complete the three-bank five times.
Shoot the top saucer for the lit Extra Ball.
Stop after the useful Extra Ball collect.
Shoot the bullseye, five-bank, and top saucer awards until base bonus reaches 12,000.
Complete the five-bank four times to reach 10X.
Shoot the bullseye and collect 120,000 at the right saucer.
Repeat the bullseye and saucer collect; scoring the bonus does not reset it.

techniques.name: Banana-flipper calibration
techniques.instruction: Make controlled test flips before you aim a narrow chute. Curved bats change shot angle and ball spin.

techniques.name: Cross-bank rebound
techniques.instruction: Shoot one drop bank so the rebound can hit the opposite bank and advance both objectives.

cautions.issue: Many copies use curved banana flippers that reduce familiar aiming control.
cautions.response: Calibrate with safe flips before you shoot the narrow bullseye chute.

cautions.issue: Second rebounds from the drop banks can reach a slingshot or outlane.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready and do not repeat a bank after its rebound becomes unpredictable.

cautions.issue: The right saucer eject returns the ball through the bumper area.
cautions.response: Watch one complete eject before you repeat the bullseye route.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm official L-2 or unofficial L-3 code and ball count.
Identify curved or straight flippers; test bullseye and saucer.

input.simpleOverview: Time Warp is a bullseye, bonus, and multiplier loop. Shoot the right bullseye chute from the left flipper for a saucer Bonus Collect, complete the right five-bank to raise Bonus X, then return to the bullseye when the built bonus is valuable.
input.overview: Time Warp uses the right bullseye and saucer for a repeatable Bonus Collect, while the right five-bank raises Bonus X. Use the left three-bank rebound to help complete the five-bank, reach 10X, then repeat the bullseye and right-saucer collect without rebuilding the bonus after each collect.
